cross_market_insights: All four SERPs are led by forums (Facebook groups, Reddit, Tripadvisor): the intent is real but no authoritative page owns it, in AU or UK.
AU top results drift to tipping and negotiating, not payment mechanics; no Australian brand page answers how to pay an overseas vendor.
UK/London shows the core worry clearly: vendors (Italy especially) asking for balances in cash, and how to pay deposits abroad.
Commercial pages in positions 4 to 10 are FX providers or transfer comparisons with savings claims; under our FIN-ADVICE-CHECK we cover the same questions without naming providers or rates.
Nobody covers invoice and payment-redirection scams, who carries the currency risk between deposit and balance, or matching the payment schedule to cancellation terms, for an Australian couple.
No result cites an official source (Moneysmart, Scamwatch, ACCC, AUSTRAC/ABF).
payload.recommended_angle: The Australian guide to paying overseas vendors safely: how deposits and balances are usually structured abroad, what each payment method means for protection and fees in general terms, how exchange-rate movement between deposit and balance changes your AUD cost, what to do when a vendor wants cash, and how to verify bank details against invoice scams, with official sources at the claim and the Wedded Advisor shown coordinating it.
